description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointments of Two Ministers
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (Hon. Vanniarachchi Pavithra Devi and Hon. Nalaka Jude Hareen Fernando) and their detailed ministerial portfolios (Minister of Irrigation, Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules. The content includes both "who" is being appointed and "what" specific responsibilities they hold.
